Item.Name: UNIT_ID
Item.Hint: Press [ENTER] to continue; [PRVFLD] to change Unit ID

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_duration VARCHAR2(6);
 temp_count number;
 temp_batch_id VARCHAR2(14);
 temp_unit VARCHAR2(15);

 v_gmt_time date;
begin
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 
 begin
 select max(coll_date)
 into :coll_date
 from units
 where unit_id = :unit_id and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;

 
 if :coll_date is null then
 GO_ITEM('s_unit_id');
 CLEAR_ITEM;
 show_error('0063');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 CHECK_INTRANSIT_INTERDICTION (:ctrl_blk_1.unit_id,
 :ctrl_blk_1.coll_date,
 :GLOBAL.chapter_id,
 null,
 null,
 :GLOBAL.warehouse,
 'INTR');
 begin
 
 select distinct 'x' into :GLOBAL.x
 from unit_attributes
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and
 trunc(coll_Date) = trunc(:ctrl_blk_1.coll_Date) 
 and attrib_group = 'PHER';
 
 GO_ITEM('s_unit_id');
 CLEAR_ITEM;
 show_error('0095');
 check_package_failure;
 
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 null;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 begin

 select bleed_start_time, first_sep_time,
 second_sep_time
 into :bleed_start_time, :s_first_sep_time,
 :s_second_sep_time
 from units
 where unit_id = :unit_id and
 trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:coll_date) and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 
 :GLOBAL.first_sep := 'N';
 :GLOBAL.second_sep := 'N';
 if :s_first_sep_time is null
 then
 :GLOBAL.first_sep := 'Y';
 else
 temp_duration := sbclib.calculate_time
 (:bleed_start_time, :s_first_sep_time);
 :first_sep_duration := nvl(temp_duration,' * ');
 if :s_second_sep_time is null
 then
 :GLOBAL.second_sep := 'Y';
 else
 temp_duration := sbclib.calculate_time
 (:bleed_start_time, :s_second_sep_time);
 :second_sep_duration := nvl(temp_duration,' * ');
 message ('Err:No more separation times can be entered for this unit');
 execute_trigger('key-clrrec');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 -- pause;
 --execute_trigger('key-clrrec');
 end if;
 end if;
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 GO_ITEM('s_unit_id');
 CLEAR_ITEM;
 show_error('1230');
 check_package_failure;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
end;

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_bleed_end_time date;

 v_gmt_time date;

begin
 nullchk;
 check_package_Failure;

--MS

 if :process_dats is not null then
 --MS Converting Local time to GMT.
 if :global.is_time_enabled = 'Y' then

 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_gmt_time(:global.chapter_id, :process_dats, v_gmt_time); 
 :global.process_dats := to_char(v_gmt_time, 'DD-MON-YYYY HH24:MI');
 else
 :global.process_dats := to_char(:process_dats, 'DD-MON-YYYY HH24:MI');
 end if;
 end if;
--
 
 --MS if :process_dats >= sysdate then
 if to_date(:global.process_dats, 'DD-MON-YYYY HH24:MI') >= sysdate then --MS
 :GLOBAL.user_err_unit_id := :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id;
 :GLOBAL.user_err_chapter_id := :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 :GLOBAL.user_err_coll_date := :ctrl_blk_1.coll_date;
 show_error('0103');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 
 if :GLOBAL.first_sep = 'Y'
 then
 begin
 select bleed_end_time
 into temp_bleed_end_time
 from units
 where unit_id = :unit_id and
 trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:coll_date)
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 
 if temp_bleed_end_time is not null and
 --temp_bleed_end_time >= :process_dats
 temp_bleed_end_time >= to_date(:global.process_dats, 'DD-MON-YYYY HH24:MI')
 then
 :GLOBAL.user_err_unit_id := :unit_id;
 :GLOBAL.user_err_chapter_id := :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 :GLOBAL.user_err_coll_date := :coll_date;
 show_error('0082');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_Failure;
 end;
 
 if trunc(:process_dats) < trunc(:coll_date) then --Ashok : IM:5398 -- coll date is being stored as chapter date.
 -- if trunc(to_date(:global.process_dats, 'DD-MON-YYYY HH24:MI')) < trunc(:coll_date) then --MS
 :GLOBAL.user_err_unit_id := :unit_id;
 :GLOBAL.user_err_chapter_id := :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 :GLOBAL.user_err_coll_date := :coll_date;
 show_error('3000');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 
end if;

 if :GLOBAL.second_sep = 'Y'
 then
 --MS if :process_dats <= :s_first_sep_time then
 if to_date(:global.process_dats, 'DD-MON-YYYY HH24:MI') <= :s_first_sep_time then --MS
 :GLOBAL.user_err_unit_id := :unit_id;
 :GLOBAL.user_err_chapter_id := :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 :GLOBAL.user_err_coll_date := :coll_date;
 show_error('3001');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
 
 exception
 when VALUE_ERROR then
 check_package_failure;
end;

Trigger.Name: ON-ERROR
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 displ_format_mask varchar2(50);
begin
 if :global.err_count = 'N' then
 :global.err_count := 'Y';
 if error_code in (50002,50003,50004, -- invalid date
 50011,50012,50021,50023,50025,50026,0) then
 if upper(substr(get_item_property(:system.cursor_item, FORMAT_MASK),1,2)) ='FX' then
 displ_format_mask:=substr(get_item_property(:system.cursor_item, FORMAT_MASK),3);
 else
 displ_format_mask:= get_item_property(:system.cursor_item, FORMAT_MASK);
 end if;
 displ_format_mask := translate(displ_format_mask, 'R', 'Y');
 show_error('0022',displ_format_mask);
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 if error_code in (50017,50018,50019,50022) then-- invalid time
 show_error('5016');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 else
 null;
 end if; 
end;

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_centrifuge_id VARCHAR2(3);
begin
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 :s_centrifuge_id := upper(:s_centrifuge_id);
 if NVL(length(:s_centrifuge_id), 0) != 5
 and :s_centrifuge_id != 'M'
 then
 :s_centrifuge_id := '';
 :centrifuge_id := '';
 show_error('1210');
 check_package_failure;
 else
 if NVL(length(:s_centrifuge_id), 0) = 5
 then
 if substr(:s_centrifuge_id,1,1) != 'C'
 or substr(:s_centrifuge_id,6,1) != 'C'
 then
 :s_centrifuge_id := '';
 :centrifuge_id := '';
 show_error('6015');
 check_package_failure;
 else
 :centrifuge_id := substr(:s_centrifuge_id,2,3);
 end if;
 end if;
 end if;
end;

Item.Name: CENTRIFUGE_ID
Item.Hint: Enter value for centrifuge ID or use [LISTVAL]

Trigger.Name: KEY-NEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_duration VARCHAR2(6);
begin
 execute_trigger('validate_field');

 check_package_failure;
 savepoint all_clear;
 :system.message_level := 5;

 begin

 if :GLOBAL.first_sep = 'Y'
 then
 temp_duration := sbclib.calculate_time(:bleed_start_time,
 --:process_dats);
 to_date(:global.process_dats, 'DD-MON-YYYY HH24:MI') ); --MS

 :first_sep_duration := nvl(temp_duration,' * ');

 update units
 set first_sep_centrifuge_id = :centrifuge_id,
 first_sep_time = to_date(:global.process_dats, 'DD-MON-YYYY HH24:MI'), --:process_dats,
 first_sep_entry_mode = 'M',
 first_sep_user_id = :banner.user_id,
 program_id = :banner.prog_name
 where unit_id = :unit_id and
 trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:coll_date) and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 end if;
 
 if :GLOBAL.second_sep = 'Y'
 then
 
 temp_duration := sbclib.calculate_time(:bleed_start_time,
 --:process_dats);
 to_date(:global.process_dats, 'DD-MON-YYYY HH24:MI') ); --MS

 :second_sep_duration := nvl(temp_duration,' * ');

 
 update units
 set second_sep_centrifuge_id = :centrifuge_id,
 second_sep_time = to_date(:global.process_dats, 'DD-MON-YYYY HH24:MI'), --:process_dats,
 second_sep_entry_mode = 'M',
 second_sep_user_id = :banner.user_id,
 program_id = :banner.prog_name
 where unit_id = :unit_id and
 trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:coll_date) and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 end if;
 
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end;

 commit;

 :system.message_level := 0;

 if form_failure
 then
 clear_form(full_rollback);
 execute_trigger('key-clrfrm');
 show_error('0230');
 check_package_failure;
 else
 show_error('8010');
 check_package_failure;
 down;
 end if;

end;

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_status varchar2(30);
begin
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 
 select status into temp_status
 from equipment
 where chapter_id = :ctrl_blk_1.s_chapter_id
 and equip_id = :centrifuge_id
 and equip_type = 'CENT'
 and sysdate between first_production_date
 and nvl(last_production_date, sysdate);
 
 if nvl(temp_status,'X') != 'IN'
 then
 temp_status := sbclib.unit_system_interdiction(:ctrl_blk_1.unit_id,
 :ctrl_blk_1.coll_date,
 :ctrl_blk_1.s_chapter_id,
 'CENT',
 LT_USER_SESSION.get_userid,
 :banner.prog_name);
 if nvl(temp_status,'x') != '0'
 then
 message('Centrifuge interdiction not assigned to unit.');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
 
exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 :s_centrifuge_id := '';
 :centrifuge_id := '';
 GO_ITEM('s_centrifuge_id');
 show_error('1142');
 check_package_failure;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
end;

Trigger.Name: ON-ERROR
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare 
 disp_format_mask varchar2(50);
begin
 if error_code = 40100 -- at first record
 then
 show_error('1700');
 elsif error_code = 40102 -- record must be entered first
 then
 show_error('1701');
 elsif error_code = 40200 -- field protected against update
 then
 show_error('1702');
 elsif error_code = 40201 -- field is full
 then
 show_error('1703');
 elsif error_code = 40202 -- field must be entered
 then
 show_error('0080');
 elsif error_code = 40207 -- must be in range
 then
 show_error('1704');
 elsif error_code = 40208 -- form in query mode, cant update
 then
 show_error('1705');
 elsif error_code = 40200 -- field protected against update
 then
 show_error('5050');
 elsif error_code in (40400,40406,40407)-- transaction committed
 then
 show_error('8010');
 elsif error_code = 40401 -- no changes to commit
 then
 show_error('8013');
 elsif error_code in (50002,50003,50004, -- invalid date
 50011,50012,50021,50023,50025,50026,0)
 then
 if upper(substr(get_item_property(:system.cursor_item, FORMAT_MASK),1,2)) ='FX' then
 disp_format_mask:=substr(get_item_property(:system.cursor_item, FORMAT_MASK),3);
 else
 disp_format_mask:= get_item_property(:system.cursor_item, FORMAT_MASK);
 end if;
 disp_format_mask := translate(disp_format_mask, 'R', 'Y');
 show_error('0022',disp_format_mask);
 elsif error_code in (50006,50007,50009, -- invalid number
 50013,50014,50015,50016,50020)
 then
 show_error('1707');
 elsif error_code in (50017,50018,50019,50022) -- invalid time
 then
 show_error('5016');
 elsif error_code in ('40209','40735') then
 null;

 /*Added by HCLC for removing double message */ 
 elsif error_code = 41000 then -- This function is not available
 null;
 else
 message(substr(error_type||'-'||to_char (error_code)
 ||': '||error_text,1,80));
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
